projects.summary: 公司给的 copilot 额度用完了，来摸鱼发个帖子，宣传下我的 Vivid Player. 今天早上第一个坏消息，我的 claude 账号历时小一年后，今早被 organization disabled 了。我打算继续用回 codex. 好消息就是我的 Vivid Player 在 Xbox one 和 Xbox Series 上可以下载使用了。 之前支持 windows10/11, 最近用 claude 把 winui3 换成了 Xbox 可用的 uwp ui 。因为之前核心的网络，渲染，解码都是在一个 c++ native 层，所有这些逻辑原封不动，几乎无迁移成本。 UI 做了一些 Xbox 的操作适配，但主体还是保留了摇杆箭头的操作逻辑。 和 KODI 那种 navigation focus 的逻辑不太一样，有好有坏，我个人还是喜欢指针操作，而且适配成本更低。 欢迎大家试用体验。 功能方面依旧是： - 4K 硬解，**杜比视界 LLDV**，HDR10, HLG, HDR Vivid 都支持； - 杜比全景声/**音频直通**也支持； - 媒体源支持 移动存储/SMB/WEBDAV/Emby/Jellyfin/Plex - 字幕/弹幕这些功能也都得到保留， - 而且优化了 Xbox 的输入体验，支持扫码输入，不用再一个个点击虚拟键盘了! （个人对这个功能很满意！ ![]( https://i.imgur.com/MK5MAYI.jpeg) ![]( https://i.imgur.com/ScE5595.jpeg)

projects.title: Formicx
projects.summary: Formicx is an open-source Debian-based operating environment optimized for AI agents, providing persistent agent deployment, framework-independent communication, multi-agent teams, cross-device networking, reusable integrations, and prebuilt autonomous agents. - Abbilaash/Formicx

projects.title: Show HN: GoNix – A Unix with a Go Userspace
projects.author: prologic
projects.summary: A UNIX-like operating system on the Linux kernel, with the userspace — init, coreutils, networking, services and SSH — written mostly in Go.

projects.title: CrabTap
projects.summary: CrabTap is a shared loyalty platform for local businesses. Print one QR code, offer stamp cards, points, and promotions, no app to build. Most loyalty tools force a choice: build a costly native app nobody downloads, or pay for infrastructure sized for big chains. CrabTap skips both. Customers get one account and one QR code across every participating venue instead of a separate card per shop. Owners get a fast scan-and-reward flow, plus promotion tools, set up in a day.

projects.title: Sound-Lab
projects.summary: Sound Lab provides professional home theater installation, custom audio/video design, and technology solutions for residential and commercial spaces. As an experienced audio video installer, we design and install reliable systems tailored to your space, entertainment needs, and budget. Our services include custom home audio systems, home theaters, media rooms, Hi-Fi and audiophile systems, commercial AV, Wi-Fi networks, lighting control, remote controls, and system integration.

projects.title: HookDeploy
projects.summary: I spent years as the accidental IT person at mid-size companies, cleaning up silently dropped webhooks after every cloud outage. So I built HookDeploy: every webhook is captured at the edge before forwarding, turning outages into a one-click replay instead of a week of manual reconciliation. Delivery to your own infra runs through a source-available mTLS agent, no open ports, no tunnel URLs. Includes a desktop agent, CLI, live Taps for local debugging, and a visual transform editor.

projects.title: Agente WhatsApp IA — Starter Kit
projects.summary: Production-ready stack to build WhatsApp AI agents without Meta's API or per-message fees. Includes: docker-compose with 4 services, importable n8n workflow, and LiteLLM as model proxy — switch between Claude, DeepSeek, GPT-4o and Gemini by editing 3 lines. No workflow changes needed. Works with any standard WhatsApp number via QR. Guided install script. Docs in Spanish. Tested in production for ordering agents in local businesses.

projects.title: superdesigndev / treg
projects.author: superdesigndev
projects.summary: OpenRouter for agent tools. Join community here: https://discord.gg/6mQYYfFMAn

projects.title: 自荐：HarnessGate —— 统一管理 40+ 编码 agent 的自托管控制台
projects.author: meichuanyi
projects.summary: 自荐一个开源项目：HarnessGate（Node.js + WebSocket，MIT）。 它是编码 agent 的"多机位导播台"：把 Claude Code、Codex、ZCode、OpenCode 等 40 多个 CLI agent 基于 ACP 协议统一接入一个自托管控制面，任何设备的浏览器或 VS Code 都能远程驱动服务器上的 agent（瘦客户端，agent 与文件都在服务器侧，客户端不碰文件）。 几个可能对周刊读者有价值的点： 1. 会话基础设施：会话落盘、服务重启自动接续（session/resume / fork / load 三级降级）、跨设备续聊、连续故障自动自愈重建并注入进度摘要； 2. 多智能体编排：「工作队」模式由工头拆解任务，队员在独立 git worktree 并行实现，异厂商评审员零共享上下文把关后合并；另有圆桌讨论（并行/串行、主持人、评分锦标赛）； 3. 运维友好：42 个 harness 自动发现/探活/可信度分级，权限三档自动决策 + 全程 JSONL 审计台账，公网访问有登录门和 token 认证。 快速开始：git clone && npm install && npm start，浏览器打开 9830 端口。

projects.title: Age Verification
projects.summary: Shufti gives you three ways to check age instead of one rigid flow, so the method matches the risk. Database lookups verify age against government and telco registries with no upload. Facial age estimation reads a live selfie, processed on-device. Document verification covers 10,000+ documents for regulated sectors. All of it is backed by iBeta Level 3 conformance and deepfake detection that blocks stolen IDs, 3D masks and AI faces. Meets COPPA, KOSA and GDPR-K. Dual Leader in Liminal's index.

projects.title: Nimply
projects.summary: Nimply is an AI social media workforce. Hire agents from a gallery: support replies, lead capture, moderation, ghostwriting, carousels, repurposing and trend scouting. They work on top of a full platform, with a planner publishing to 9 networks, a unified inbox and a visual automation canvas. The rule that matters: agents draft, you approve. They cannot publish without you. Free plan, no card. Paid from $9.99/mo. iOS, Android, browser extension, public API and MCP server included.

projects.title: Scalar — build apps that last
projects.summary: Build with AI. Keep your software maintainable. Scalar is an application foundation for AI-assisted development. Instead of starting from an empty repository, you start with a small, production-ready codebase that already handles the fundamentals — authentication, database, migrations, jobs, PWA, AI, and more. Scalar has its focus on simplicity as a foundation for complexity. The stack stays understandable, so your application can grow without software entropy making it harder to maintain.

projects.title: Show HN: I gave Jev my forum database so he could find the most relevant
projects.author: bigmuzzy
projects.summary: I have a service for placing backlinks on forums—specifically within discussion threads—and it involves a massive database of forums. We gave Jav the task of sorting through it and showed him what the process looks like. He sifted through the list and kept only the highest-quality forums where backlinks can be posted within discussions. Any questions?

projects.title: Logsblox
projects.summary: Logsblox is agent-native application log storage priced on what you ingest. Flat 12-months of retention is included on paid plans — one tier, no retention fees, no infrastructure to run. OpenTelemetry native, so it fits the collectors you already use. Free to start: 500 MB/day, 14-day retention, one project, no credit card.

projects.title: KeeperPass
projects.summary: An open-source password manager with no server and no database. Your vault is one encrypted file in your own Google Drive — encrypted on your device, so the only thing Google receives is ciphertext it can't read. Argon2id + AES-256-GCM. One OAuth scope. Free forever, AGPL-3.0. Autofill, TOTP, password generator, multiple vaults. Nothing to breach, because there's nothing to hold.

projects.title: Fyralynx
projects.summary: Fyralynx routes every affiliate link to the highest-earning store and network for each click, using your own affiliate accounts, so you keep 100% of the commission. International clicks land on the visitor's local store, not a dead one. No black box: a routing console explains every decision. Global-native: 35 merchants, 7 networks, 25+ countries (India, Africa, MENA, SE Asia, LATAM). Free tier: 500 clicks/month, no card. Chrome + Firefox. Privacy-first: local analytics by default.

projects.title: UK Pre-Seed Investor Hit-List
projects.summary: A hand-researched hit-list of 115 UK pre-seed investors — accelerators, angel networks, EIS/SEIS funds, micro-VCs. 62 official contact routes, each verified on the investor's own site. Top 20 ranked with the named partner who leads pre-seed, their thesis, and portfolio. No guessed emails.

projects.title: Saleshunt
projects.summary: Describe your ideal customer in one sentence. Saleshunt finds the companies that match, the right people to contact, and drafts outreach worth sending. It researches live sources instead of a stale database, learns from every reply, and goes deepest where US tools go thin: European markets. First 25 leads are free.

projects.title: OpenKOS
projects.summary: OpenKOS is open-source, self-hosted property management software for boarding houses, rentals, and apartments. Manage properties, units, tenants, leases, invoices, payments, expenses, and maintenance from one application. Unlike hosted-only property management tools, OpenKOS can run on infrastructure you control, with its source code available under the Apache 2.0 license.

projects.title: Show HN: BuildABrowser (Java) – Passes Acid2, Has CSS Grid and an Android port
projects.author: everyos_
projects.summary: BuildABrowser Browser is an open-source browser and its rendering engine. It runs on Linux, Windows, and (experimental) Android Desktop. The rendering engine is written in Java, and features parsers and layout algorithms written from scratch. It is also embeddable, with pre-made embedding layers for Swing and Android Jetpack Compose. Because the renderer is modular, though, it is also possible to port the renderer to other platforms. GitHub repository: https://github.com/BuildABrowser/BuildABrowser Demo Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xWF7YPIoks8 (edit: there's now also a video on the channel of submitting the post from BAB) The browser has support for the following: * Layouts: flow/flow-root, flex, grid, table, inline variants of all prior listed - Note: subgrid is not supported. Some alignment properties present in flex are missing from grid. - Note: Table only supports `table-layout: auto`, not fixed * Positioning Schemes: static, relative, absolute, sticky, fixed * Floating and cleared elements * CSS Combinators: Child, Descendant, Next-Sibling, Subsequent-Sibling * CSS Selectors: ID, type, class, attribute * CSS Pseudo-Classes/Elements: :hover, :link, :focus, :focus-within, :focus-visible, :has, :is, :not, :where, :first-child, :last-child, :only-child, :nth-child, :first-of-type, :last-of-type, :only-of-type, ::before, ::after * CSS Functions: calc (and related functions), var * CSS layers (the `@layer` at-rules) * Media Queries: screen type, min/max-width/height media features * Text selection, text fields, GET/POST forms, cycle focus via tab button, and fragment navigation * (Linux) Support for A11Y via a fork of AccessKit (Experimental, enable with `-a11y accesskit`). Designed for Orca - other tools may not work. * (Linux/Windows/fallback) Includes a utility to view a page's DOM tree * (Linux/Windows) Skija (Skia) and Java2D graphics backends, HttpClient network backend * (Android Desktop) android.graphics graphics backend, OkHttp network backend Please note that BuildABrowser does not support JS at this time Thanks to the browser not supporting paste, I had to retype all this... Hopefully it goes through. Also, BAB spoofs the User-Agent on HN, please check Sec-CH-UA instead.

projects.title: MeloQA
projects.summary: MeloQA is an all-in-one QA management platform covering the full testing lifecycle: test case management, test cycles, manual execution, bug tracking, and reporting dashboards. It integrates natively with Jira, Azure DevOps, Asana, and Businessmap, plus a public API for custom workflows. MeloAI adds AI-powered test case generation from user stories or recorded flows, and automated test script creation, helping QA teams cut manual work and keep full requirement traceability.

projects.title: Flutter AI Starter Kit
projects.summary: Stop spending weeks setting up boilerplate. Flutter AI Starter Kit gives you a complete, production-ready foundation for mobile & web apps. Includes GPT-4o & OpenAI API integrations, Supabase backend (auth & database), clean architecture, dark/light themes, and built-in paywall flows. Built for indie hackers and developers wanting to ship AI SaaS apps fast.

projects.title: Skontro
projects.summary: Skontro compares crypto exchanges by what a trade really costs: fee plus hidden spread, measured every hour on the live order books of eleven exchanges. Type your amount, see every exchange ranked by what you actually receive. Plus a monthly index with permalinks and JSON API, a sourced reliability score per exchange, and withdrawal fees by network. Read-only.

projects.title: See It Flow
projects.summary: You can't Google a concept you don't know exists. Many engineers never learn ideas like idempotency, backpressure, or CQRS simply because nobody ever pointed them there. SeeItFlow organizes system design, databases, and backend concepts into structured paths so you discover what's missing, then explains each one visually, through animated walkthroughs, diagrams, and text, so you can see the whole system's flow end to end. Free, no sign-in.

projects.title: NetBlocker
projects.summary: NetBlocker is a deliberately simple outbound firewall for Apple silicon Macs. Drag an app into the list to block its new network connections. NetBlocker also discovers and displays related helpers, XPC services and background processes, so one rule covers more than the visible app. There are no connection-by-connection popups, accounts or subscriptions. It includes a 7-day free trial, costs €4.99 once and comes with a 30-day money-back guarantee.

projects.title: AI SRE
projects.summary: Atatus AI SRE investigates production incidents across logs, metrics, traces, infrastructure, and deployments, correlating evidence, identifying root causes, and recommending remediation before your team spends hours chasing signals. Now generally available for production teams.

projects.title: Packmates AI - Smart Packing Assistant
projects.summary: Most packing checklists are a static template or a one-off chatbot answer. Packmates AI builds your list from your actual destination, dates, real-time weather, and planned activities — pulling from a database of 250+ items instead of guessing. Invite packmates and everyone sees the same list update live, so nothing gets double-packed or missed. Change your dates or add an activity and the list adjusts itself. Free on web + iOS.

projects.title: Free Gift Card
projects.summary: Glow & Go Beauty Gift Card.Not sure what to gift a beauty lover? Glow & Go is a digital $75 gift card that lets them choose what they love. Easy to share, flexible, and personal. Choose → Share → They Pick. What would make a digital gift card more useful for you? Explore: https://www.profitableratecpmnetwork.com/p8jatnqcw?key=a4e2c4ed3431c9c9f8e1c49163c6364e⁠�

projects.title: Outposts
projects.summary: Outposts watches nine networks (Reddit, X, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Threads, YouTube, HN, Instagram, TikTok) for people asking for what you sell, and drafts the reply in your voice. It never signs in to your accounts and never posts. You do, from your own handle.

projects.title: BlockWyse
projects.summary: We design, build and run the technology institutions need to navigate and participate in crypto markets, combining institutional-grade infrastructure with the market intelligence required.

projects.title: Desktops
projects.summary: Desktops is a sleek macOS menu bar utility that shows your active desktops at a glance. So you always know where you at, in terms of desktops on macOS. You get the mental picture of your macOS workspace and helps you multitask. Click to switch. Customisable styles. Lightweight and native.

projects.title: Google Indexer
projects.summary: Google Indexer is a fast indexing tool for websites and backlinks. Submit URL lists, get crawl status on every link, and move pages out of “waiting forever” limbo. Flat pricing: $0.39 per URL. Crypto only. No KYC. Refunds if a task fails. If you publish content, build links, or run client SEO — this is the shortcut to getting those URLs fetched.

projects.title: Replaceme
projects.summary: Free native Mac menu bar app. It follows your Mail, Messages and notifications and texts you a short brief through iMessage with what needs your attention. No new inbox, no API key. Runs on Jev, TypeSafe's new decision model, fast and cheap enough to check every message. That's why it's free. Content goes to hosted AI and isn't stored. The privacy page says exactly what leaves your Mac. macOS 14+.

projects.title: Lume
projects.summary: Lume is a native Windows notes app (WinUI 3, no Electron) that stays hidden until you need it. Shake your mouse or press a shortcut, write, and it's gone. Beyond quick notes: a scratchpad that does maths as you type and runs small Python, JS or PowerShell snippets, pen ink right on top of your text, and freehand boards next to your notes. Local-first, optional OneDrive sync. Free for up to 20 notes.

projects.title: OmniMac
projects.summary: Free, open-source macOS menu bar app: a Dynamic Island that works on Macs without a notch, per-app volume and equaliser, window layouts, clipboard, OCR. 0.017–0.033 % CPU.

projects.title: ChatGPT Update Notifier
projects.summary: Well, I kept missing ChatGPT desktop app updates and was suprised that the Linux app did not have an update flow built-in. I am sure OpenAI will eventually address this. Until then, here is a small, unofficial notifier for the ChatGPT desktop app on Linux. The Windows version of the app already has this update-checker feature. It checks the signed OpenAI package repository and reminds you about newer app versions. It never installs an update without your confirmation.

projects.title: Flotnote
projects.summary: Flotnote is a Markdown notepad that floats above every app on your Mac. Hit one shortcut, write the thought down, and get back to work. Every note is a plain Markdown file in a folder you choose, so Obsidian and any other editor can open it right away. Full-text search, wiki-style links, tags, and several floating notes at once. No account, no servers, no subscription.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】OrbCue：替你盯着命令行 Agent 的windows桌面小球，减少你的“上下文切换”
projects.author: QZYH123

github.name: QZYH123/OrbCue
github.description: Desktop orb for Windows that cues you when Claude Code, Grok, Codex or Cursor Agent needs you. Working sessions show a count; waiting/failed sessions get a ? / ! plus a notification. Local-only, hook-based, no conversation reading.

projects.summary: OrbCue 是 Windows 桌面上的一颗悬浮小球，解决的是人在盯着多agent进度时总要专注或者不断"上下文切换"来轮询不同会话的进度的问题，它替你盯着 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Grok Build等命令行 Agent。它利用hook把轮询优化为中断逻辑，把 Windows 和WSL 里的所有会话汇总在一起：谁在工作、谁在等你、谁做完了一眼可见，还会弹通知或推送到手机，点一下就能跳回对应终端。 适合同时跑多个 Agent、或者挂着长任务去做别的事的时候用。项目用 Rust 和 Tauri 2 开发，界面基于Svelte，只读取工具自带的 hook 事件，不读对话内容。 功能： • 状态汇总：所有 Agent 会话汇总到同一颗球上，显示工作中、等待输入、等待授权、完成、失败。 • 多工具接入：支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor CLI、Grok Build，装在 Windows 或 WSL 里的都能接入，其他工具也可以通过命令自行接入。 • 提醒：弹系统通知并响提示音，可选通过 ntfy 推送到手机。 • 跳回终端：点一下回到对应终端。用 orb run 或"原命令启动"开的会话，能精确跳到那个标签页。 • 一键连接：自动发现已安装的工具，一键写入 hook，改之前自动备份，断开时只撤掉自己写的部分。 • 隐私：只读取 hook 事件，不读对话内容，数据只留在本机。 • 小球交互：可以贴边收起、调透明度，支持全局快捷键、开机自启和多套主题。

projects.title: Driftpad
projects.summary: Driftpad is a free Mac menu bar app for notes that clean up after themselves. One click on its icon opens a note that floats above every app, desktop and full-screen window. Type a reminder, number or idea and carry on: after 2 seconds the note turns see-through so it never blocks your work, and when its time runs out (1 minute to 1 hour) it disappears. Pin the notes worth keeping. Hovering or typing pauses the countdown. No permissions, no account, no internet needed. Made by Phantom.

projects.title: Focus Shield
projects.summary: Focus Shield is a free Mac menu bar app that blocks YouTube, Netflix, X, Instagram, LinkedIn and Prime Video in Chrome and Safari. Want to switch it off? First you read three short facts from books on attention by Jonathan Haidt, Johann Hari, Cal Newport and Gloria Mark. Still sure? Pause it for 30 minutes or an hour, and it turns itself back on. New in 1.2: automatic updates. Signed and notarized by Apple, no account needed, and your browsing never leaves your Mac.

projects.title: Loupe for Kubernetes
projects.summary: Loupe is a free, open-source Kubernetes desktop app built in Rust. It reads your kubeconfig and gives you live lists, logs across every replica, shells, port-forwards, Helm, CRDs and diffed YAML edits, with read-only guards on production. Apache-2.0.

projects.title: Waslane
projects.summary: Apple's Continuity stops at the iPhone, Phone Link stops at Windows. Waslane brings your Android phone to your Mac and iPad: mirror and control the screen, send files both ways, read and answer SMS, get notifications with inline reply, share the clipboard, browse photos and contacts. Everything runs over your own Wi-Fi with TLS 1.3, no server, no account, no tracking. Free 7-day trial, then $12.99/year or $29.99 once. The Android companion app is free.

projects.title: videoCn
projects.summary: videoCn is a complete video player for shadcn/ui. One command installs it, and it picks up your project's theme: colors, radius, light and dark mode. Every control is a prop, so there is nothing to rebuild, yet the code is yours to edit. MP4 and WebM play natively; HLS, DASH and live streams go through Shaka Player, loaded only when needed. Features : - chapters - quality selector - keyboard shortcuts - accessible sliders included Free and open source. A lot is coming (subtitles, heatmap...)

projects.title: Deskbit
projects.summary: Native macOS sticky notes with pinning, group selection, auto-arrange, rich text, Markdown shortcuts, and history recovery. Notes stay on your Mac with no account required. Open source under MIT, with English and Simplified Chinese interfaces.

projects.title: Usage Buddy
projects.summary: UsageBuddy gives developers one place to track their Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor usage. Add multiple accounts, see remaining limits and reset times, and get alerts before you run out. Everything is visible in a simple desktop app, so you don’t have to open multiple tools or remember which account has usage left.

projects.title: Godmode Bot
projects.summary: Most AI agents stop at the login screen. Godmode Bot gives Claude a real browser plus a local, encrypted vault for your logins and 2FA codes, and types them into the page itself, so the model never sees a password. Build persistent agents with their own memory (each one is a git repo), cron routines and delegation, plus an inbox where agents report missing logins. Desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux, or self-host it with a web dashboard. Free and MIT.

projects.title: Dial • Time Tracker
projects.summary: A simple time tracker for the Mac menu bar. One click starts a project, another switches, and ⌥⌘T opens it from any app. What makes it different: Dial notices the meetings and calls you forgot to track. It reads your calendar and sees when Zoom, Meet or Teams is using the mic (it never listens), then asks before adding the time. Nothing counts until you say yes. Fully local: no account, no server, your time never leaves your Mac. 11 MB. Free for 7 days, then $49 once or $3.99/month.

projects.title: FileSorter Pro
projects.summary: FileSorter Pro is a lightweight desktop tool that automatically organizes messy folders by file type (images, documents, videos, audio) and batch-renames files with a custom prefix, number, and optional date — all with a preview before anything changes. No command line needed, no complex setup — just pick a folder and go. Built for anyone tired of manually sorting downloads. Works on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

projects.title: Heimdall
projects.summary: The all-seeing, privacy-conscious watchman inside Ruune Desktop. Heimdall reads what's on your screen, matches it against your meetings and conversation history, and drafts the reply right where your cursor is - in Slack, Mail, Chrome, anywhere. He also cleans up dictation on the fly and translates idiomatically, one shortcut per language. Everything stays on your Desktop Better Wisprflow + Granola + Memory graph + AI Assistant with Online, Offline capture

projects.title: Billed
projects.summary: Billed is a lightweight Windows desktop app for freelancers and small businesses who want simple invoicing without recurring fees. Create invoices, generate PDFs, manage clients, track paid/overdue status, and export to Excel — all stored locally on your machine. Pay $4.99 once. No subscriptions, ever.

projects.title: QRForge — QR Code Generator
projects.summary: QRForge is a free Chrome extension that generates QR codes instantly, 100% on your device. Nothing is uploaded to any server: no accounts, no tracking, no ads. Features: text/URL input, 4 built-in themes plus custom colors, PNG and SVG download, copy to clipboard, right-click context menus for pages, links and selected text, download sizes 256/512/1024, and local history of your last 20 codes. Open source (MIT).

projects.title: CodeRook
projects.summary: CodeRook keeps every version of any project, from code to multi-GB game assets, as compressed snapshots. Its engine, CBX, is open source (Apache 2.0): save, branch and merge offline, then push to CodeRook when you want it there. The storage format and sync protocol are published. Desktop app, command line and web. Never used to train AI. 5 GB free, no card.

projects.title: Sharpshot
projects.summary: Press a shortcut, drag a box, and the shot comes back at your screen's real pixel size: on the clipboard, saved to a folder, and open in an editor with arrows, boxes, numbered steps, mosaic and crop. Pin a shot on top while you work, read its text or QR code offline, pick colours as HEX or SwiftUI. No network permission, no account, no analytics, no rating prompts, no cross-promotion. One purchase, English and Chinese, macOS 14 or later.

projects.title: BudgetFlow
projects.summary: BudgetFlow is a modern, native Windows monthly budget planner built for 100% privacy. • 100% Offline Vault: No servers, no accounts, and zero tracking. • 50/30/20 & Envelopes: Smart allocation for Needs, Wants, and Savings. • Multi-Currency: Full support for $, €, £, ₹, ¥, CAD, AUD. • Windows 11 Fluent UI: Fast desktop app with dark mode. • Honest Pricing: 30-day free trial, then $14.99 one-time lifetime license. No subscriptions.

projects.title: [开源推荐] dtflow：在终端里像看对话一样浏览 LLM 训练数据
projects.author: KenyonY

github.name: KenyonY/dtflow
github.description: Terminal browser for LLM training data with mouse support, windowed loading and full-file search — plus a CLI toolbox to filter, clean, convert and export datasets

projects.summary: 最近自己做了个 macOS 菜单栏小工具，叫 Kipless 。 最开始其实就是我自己有这个需求。我平时会让 codex 在后台跑任务，碰到下班的时候任务还没跑完就很烦。同事都跑路了，我也急着走，但一合盖电脑就睡了，通勤路上的时间也浪费掉了，到家还得接着等。 所以我想要的其实就是：合盖，塞包里，路上让它继续跑。 一开始也用过一些现成的防休眠软件。这类工具很多，不是什么新东西。 但用下来发现，我自己的需求刚好有三种： - 电脑别睡，屏幕正常灭 - 电脑和屏幕都别睡 - 合盖以后也继续跑 有的软件有前两个，有的软件能解决最后一个。我想三个都要，又不想来回换工具，最后干脆自己写了一个。 Kipless 现在就是这三个模式，再加一个很简单的定时，可以跑 15 分钟、30 分钟、1 小时、2 小时，或者一直开着。 我自己用得最多的还是合盖模式。尤其是下班前 Codex 还在干活的时候，开着 Kipless 合盖走人，到家再看它跑得怎么样。 有一点要提前说明： MAS 版没有合盖继续运行。 合盖模式用到了一些 MAS 不允许的系统级能力，所以这个功能没办法跟着 App Store 版一起上架。 因此： - GitHub 开源版：三个模式都有。 - App Store 版：只有前两个模式，没有合盖模式，是因为受到 MAS 限制。 整个 App 是 Swift 写的，无收集、除了检查更新之外不联网。纯粹想着上架看看能不能赚个奶茶钱。 前几天 App Store 版也终于过审了，所以来分享一下。 官网： https://shiinalabs.com/zh/kipless/ GitHub： https://github.com/ShiinaLabs/Kipless App Store： https://apps.apple.com/app/kipless/id6812832674 如果你也经常挂 codex 、cc 啥的，应该比较容易理解我为什么要做这个东西。 欢迎拍砖喵

projects.title: Show HN: swe-mux – A terminal multiplexer for coding agents optimized for mobile
projects.author: jatora
projects.summary: I run a lot of coding agents at once, mostly Claude Code, Codex and pi, across several projects. I got tired of having so many windows open, of agents leaving hung processes behind, of tracking which one needed input, and of having to remote into my desktop or SSH into a single shell to manage them from my phone. Even then, a terminal on a phone couldn't show me the frontend or output I needed to verify the work. I tried Orca and herdr. Both were better than my setup, but neither had a real WYSIWYG markdown notes surface, and neither had a phone interface I could actually work in. swe-mux is the terminal multiplexer I built for that. It runs any shell or CLI in real terminals on your own machine and serves the same live sessions to your desktop and your phone. It's built around agents: Claude Code, Codex, opencode, pi and oh-my-pi get a live status (working, done, or waiting on you), searchable history and resume. Anything else runs as an ordinary terminal with everything except the status. This is the actual terminal and not a UI wrapped around the agent, and you can just use it that way, or start claude in a plain shell and that pane becomes an agent session. On the desktop it's panes and tabs of sessions, notes, files and dev-server previews. Input behaves the same across agents: Shift+Enter, Ctrl+Backspace, paste and click-to-position work in all of them, shortcuts come from presets (tmux, VS Code, Vim, Emacs), and you can paste images straight from the clipboard. Notes and any markdown file in the project open in the same WYSIWYG editor, on desktop and phone, and autosave. No more scattered locations for notes. On the phone it's the same sessions over your own Tailscale network, installed as a PWA: the terminal with a usable keyboard, git diff review, files, notes, and push notifications when an agent needs a decision. A dev server on the host's 127.0.0.1 is proxied through swe-mux, so the phone can open it without exposing another port. Being able to play-test and check a frontend there is what finally closed the development loop on the phone for a lot of my projects. Now I can and do swe anywhere. It's a problem Two things I use constantly: a prompt queue, so something I think of mid-turn waits until the agent is done instead of interrupting it, and messaging between sessions, so a Codex session can ask a Claude session something. I don't want my workflow tied to one provider. General architecture: Sessions survive restarts. A separate supervisor process owns the terminals, so the daemon can restart and the app can update without killing anything. I update it several times a day, so this wasn't optional. Status comes from the CLI's hooks, its transcript and the terminal itself, because no single one reliably tells "waiting on you" apart from "busy in the background". There's no swe-mux account, no server of mine in the path, and no telemetry. Just your tailnet It was built on Windows, which is where I use it every day and the only platform with a packaged desktop app. The installer is unsigned, so the PyPI install is the way to avoid the SmartScreen prompt. macOS and Linux run the daemon and use a browser. CI runs it on all three, but I haven't lived on those myself, however Linux I have tested. Demo, the real UI with simulated agents, nothing to install: https://swemux.dev/demo/ Install: `uv tool install swe-mux` (or `pipx install swe-mux`), then run `swe-mux` on Windows or `swemux start` elsewhere. Apache-2.0: https://github.com/jatoran/swe-mux I've put a lot of work into the initial user experience to help streamline a quick setup depending on someone's needs, feedback greatly appreciated, thanks

projects.title: Show HN: Caspian – Desktop app to build and launch small vibe-coded projects
projects.author: sshussain270
projects.summary: Hi! I am Hussain and I built Caspian. For someone who vibe builds almost all the time, for both personal tools like investment or health dashboards or tools to help others, I found my projects scattered all over the place: researching with claude, writing context in notion, building with Claude Code, Devin, publishing in vercel, posthog for analytics and then others tools for GTM. Big part of brain energy drain was context switching, I wasn't very organized. So I decided to build that lets me do all this from one place. I built Caspian. While most AI coding tools you use for vibe building stop at code, Caspian takes it all the way to users. Caspian creates a "workbench" folder in your local machine where it puts all your projects so everything stays in one place and is also easy for your other tools to work with. There is a built in co-pilot, a context manager (.md files user can copilot both read/write), a one click publisher, analytics and an email outreach manager. Though the copilot uses API for processing LLM requests via open router (I make a little margin on top), it is pricy, so I build a standard "canvas" format that Caspian uses that your Claude/Codex or other tools you use also understand and can work with. Simply point them to https://caspian.md/docs and they'll learn to work with Caspian straight away, this is so that you're not tied to Caspian's co-pilot and if you prefer to use your own tools, you can do so. Some other features I built around problems i found myself struggle with: - Prompt refinement: Enter a vague prompt in co-pilot, caspian uses a cheap model to generate a detailed before starting the task. - Preflight: It breaks down the task and tells you estimatedly, how much will it cost and how long will it take, before starting the task. - Product and User context: Co-pilot has access to the two files so both you and Caspain has understand of your product and user. - Code/No code: You can switch this button to dive into code or just stick with the vibes. I hope it helps and you can build and launch a lot quickly. Feedback what's the most annoying thing when you vibe code?

projects.summary: OncePower 是一款 Flutter + Rust 写的开源桌面端批量重命名与文件整理工具，支持 Windows / Linux（暂需自行通过项目 Action 打包）、中英双语。它解决的是整理照片和视频素材时的典型痛点：边看内容边定顺序、再批量改名。所有规则可视化配置，不需要学正则也能完成高级匹配替换。 亮点 1. 视图模式：列表里直接显示图片缩略图，双击看大图，视频可直接播放并自动生成封面——不用先切到资源管理器确认"这到底是哪个文件"。 2. 拖拽即命名顺序：拖动列表项就能调整顺序，拖出来的顺序就是编号 / 序列命名的顺序；配合 Ctrl / Shift 多选和暂存区做批量搬移，全程所见即所得，不用"改完名再看效果、不对再改"。 3. 不用学正则：替换、保留、高级模式（删除 / 添加 / 序列 / 随机数 / 转换 / 格式化 / 单词间隔）全是可视化选项；常用规则可存成"预设"反复复用。 4. 组模式：不同组套用不同的命名规则，一批文件一次搞定多种命名风格。 5. CSV / TXT 导入命名：外部改好名称表直接导入；也能导入它自己生成的日志，一键还原成原来的文件名。 6. 整理模式：改完名可直接按组 / 类型 / 日期把文件移动到不同文件夹，顺带清理空文件夹。 7. 系统右键菜单集成（Windows）＋ 开机自启，在资源管理器里右键就能把文件塞进列表（需自行开启该功能）。 截图或演示视频 以下动图为了减少体积进行过删帧，所以看起来会有点卡顿

projects.title: Accent Letters for Mac
projects.summary: macOS press-and-hold is genuinely good — until you need ł, đ, ș or þ, none of which are on it. Accent Letters is a free Mac app. All 682 accented letters in the menu bar, grouped A to Z, each with its keyboard shortcut and HTML entity. Click one and it is on your clipboard. Search by the letter itself, by its Unicode name, by language, or in plain words: "two dots", "squiggle", "hat". Works offline. No account, no ads, no tracking.

projects.title: AppleFileViewer
projects.summary: Free, open-source desktop app to explore local iPhone backups: photos & albums, Messages, WhatsApp, calls, voicemail, notes, voice memos and contacts. Supports encrypted backups, global search and PDF/CSV export. Fully offline — no account, no telemetry.

projects.title: 【工具自荐】OmniDock：把 Dock 预览、窗口操作和常用快捷功能放进一个 Mac 应用
projects.author: quanzhankeji
projects.summary: 我是 OmniDock 的开发者，平时经常在 Windows 和 Mac 之间工作。有些 Windows 上的操作更符合我的习惯，比如鼠标停在应用图标上查看窗口、再次点击图标收起应用。我想把这些习惯适配到 Mac，同时少装几个单功能工具，于是做了 OmniDock。 目前它把 Dock 窗口预览与点击隐藏/唤起、窗口切换、每应用快捷键、窗口布局、本地可搜索剪贴板历史、Finder 右键扩展和菜单栏图标整理放在一个应用里，支持中英文。 它不是要把 macOS 完全变成 Windows，也不声称能完整替代每一个专业工具，而是集中解决日常反复用到的操作。Finder 扩展受系统支持范围限制；菜单栏整理需要用户手动移动图标，不是自动分类。

projects.title: ThreadTrim for Gmail
projects.summary: Every Gmail reply quietly carries the whole conversation underneath it. On a long thread, your one-line reply drags 60+ old emails along, and everyone has to scroll past them to find what's new. ThreadTrim removes the old quoted emails before you hit Send, so only what you wrote goes out. Works with Reply, keyboard shortcuts and pop-outs, with one-click Undo. Runs entirely in your browser: no account, no servers, no tracking. Free for 20 trimmed replies a month.

projects.title: QuickSwitch
projects.summary: QuickSwitch puts the phone controls you reach for most in one simple screen. Adjust volume and brightness, toggle the flashlight, and jump to Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, hotspot, GPS, or system settings without digging through menus. Start with the free essentials, then unlock advanced shortcuts with a 7-day trial and a one-time purchase.

projects.title: WattMate
projects.summary: WattMate sits in the Mac menu bar and shows which app is draining the battery right now, in watts, and how many minutes you get back if you quit it. 2 minutes after you quit, it measures again and prints what really changed. Apple silicon, macOS 14+.

projects.title: 集成 tailscale 的 android SSH/SFTP 终端
projects.author: netox
projects.summary: 之前分享过我的 iOS 应用 NovaScale(原名 NovaAccess), 它直接集成了 Tailscale 内核, 把 SSH/SFTP/Remote Codex 这些功能整合到一个 App 里, 无需开启 Tailscale VPN 客户端, 也可以在有 VPN 运行的情况下运行, 目前还在积极迭代基于 herdr remote 协议, 以满足像我这样重度 Tailscale 用户远程开发以及维护服务的一些需求 距离之前发贴已经有一段时间了，这期间 iOS 版本增加了很多新功能，同时也修复了一些 libtailscale 的问题(相关修复开源在 https://github.com/GalaxNet-Ltd/libtailscale 不知道为啥, 感觉 Tailscale 的 iOS 有些严重问题上游修复的不积极, 比如这个断网问题: https://github.com/tailscale/tailscale/issues/19504); 与此同时, 我也一直在用多余的 codex 额度(pro 5x 用户, 近期 reset 实在时太多了), 在开发一个全免费全开源的 Play 版本, 用来满足当时一些国内外用户提到的 android 版本需求 由于之前的一些方案感觉不理想, 在 5.6/astra 发布后又进了一些优化, 感觉逐渐达到了自己可用的情况, 甚至为 SSH terminal 增加基于 SGR 的鼠标支持(herdr 这种 mouse native 的 TUI 应用需要)基本上 Astra 一发就差不多了 最近重新把之前的 play 开发者账号用了起来, 全部委托给 codex 负责截图、描述、商店操作(甚至如何搞授权也是 codex 告诉我的, 相比 iOS 开发要复杂点), 没想到当前提交隔天就通过了 因此发在这里也分享给有需要的朋友, 提前声明如下: 1 、这是一个完全免费的应用，代码完全开源 ( https://github.com/GalaxNet-Ltd/novascale-android), 与 iOS 版本不同, 没有采用 libtailscale, 直接让 codex 基于 tailscale 源码适配 2 、半年前的最初版本大概还是 claude 做的, 感觉做的不怎么样, 当前完全由 Codex 开发, 我只负责架构文档和最终的验收, 所以可以称之外完全 AI 开发并发布的版本, 后面可能会根据用户反馈、时间和 Codex 额外会进行一些迭代; 总体上感觉满足我有时候 iPhone 没电时用 Android 手机的需求 3 、代码为 GPL 协议, 原因在于从 termux 上借了一些 terminal rendering 的代码, 这部分它的协议是 GPL 的, 因此也只能 GPL 开源 Android 版本 NovaScale 的一些主要功能如下: - 无需安装 Tailscale 官方 App ，因此可以同时使用其他 VPN - 基于 libghostty(准确说是 libghostty-vt 库) + Termux 渲染方案 - 支持鼠标操作（因此 tmux / herdr 等场景可以正常使用） - 支持剪贴板功能（包括 OSC52 ） - 支持自定义控制服务器(即支持 headscale 或其他自建 tailscale coordinator) - 内置 SFTP 文件浏览器，支持直接编辑文件, 以及少量代码类型的高度支持 - 内置浏览器，可访问 tailnet 内部的 Web 服务 - 支持后台代理，让第三方应用使用 tailnet 连接, 例如你正在使用其他非 Tailscale VPN 时，也可以配合 Termius 等 SSH 客户端连接服务器 技术架构如下: - tailscale 源码包装出 lib - russh 通过 ffi 与 tailscale lib 进行通信, 实现 ssh 通道 - 使用 termux 提供的代码实现了一个 terminal UI 的渲染 - tailscale lib 中提供一个 socks5 代理, 此代理供浏览器实现基于 MagicDNS 的访问, 同时这个代理可以提供给其他进程使用 如果你是 Android 用户，并且对此感兴趣，可以通过如下链接下载: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=cc.galaxnet.novascale 简单推广下 iOS 版 NovaScale ，它包含 Android 版的全部功能，基础功能免费, 有少量的付费功能需要订阅或买断支持: - 多 tailnet 支持 - 基于内置 Tailscale 和主机 Codex App-Server 直接交互的远程 Codex 方案(无需第三方中转) - 服务器监控 - Docker 管理 目前我还在尝试通过 herdr 的协议实现原生 herdr 支持，让它能够像 herdr remote 一样工作。 iOS 版本可通过如下链接下载: https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/novascale-%E4%B8%93%E4%B8%BA-tailscale-%E6%89%93%E9%80%A0/id6749938291 PS: 1 、最近看到 tailscale CEO 也忍不住充了点 codex 的额度, vibe 了一个内置 Tailscale 的 jellyfin 客户端, 同样也是基于 libtailscale 实现的, 有需要用户可以去他的 X 的帖子上翻翻应该能找到 testflight 2 、作为 tailscale 的重度用户, 也欢迎私信技术交流

projects.title: ZenFirst - One thing at a time.
projects.summary: ZenFirst blocks every app on your phone until your routine is complete. No shortcuts. No excuses. Unlike app blockers, ZenFirst doesn't just remove distractions — it replaces them with your routine: meditation, journaling, tasks. Unlike habit apps, ZenFirst doesn't send notifications you ignore. It takes over your phone until the work is done. Features: - Built-in: meditation, journal, tasks and more - Custom modules - Streak tracking - iOS & Android

projects.title: 【工具自荐】Start This Task：把大任务拆成一个可以开始的动作
projects.author: cnvxstudio
projects.summary: 大家好，我是 Ethan Lee，分享自己在做的效率工具 Start This Task。 产品地址： 它主要帮助处理“任务太大或太模糊，不知道从哪里开始”的情况：输入任务后，先得到一个具体的起步动作，再展开成可编辑的步骤计划。 主要功能： 可以选择 Standard、Small 或 Tiny 的步骤粒度。 某一步仍然太大时，可以继续拆分。 可以编辑计划，并用 Focus Mode 和可调整的倒计时专注当前一步。 例如，把“准备一个产品演示”从笼统目标变成先写出演示目标、再逐项推进的行动计划。它不是替你自动完成任务，而是帮助你更容易开始。 产品有免费使用选项，也有付费功能，不是开源项目。欢迎对任务拆分的实用性、步骤粒度和专注模式提出反馈。

projects.title: 【工具自荐】ToolSide-浏览器侧边栏工具箱，34个本地小工具，让你的效率直接起飞
projects.author: ovelv
projects.summary: 浏览器右侧的超级工具箱：图片压缩、OCR、PDF 合并、JSON 格式化等 30+ 工具随手可用，不搜索、不切 Tab。 装一个 ToolSide，就不用装十几个插件了，也不用四处找小工具网站了。 ToolSide 把高频小工具收进浏览器侧边栏：遇到问题，点开侧边栏搜索即用，用完即走，全程不切换标签页。 ToolSide官网： 【核心能力】 ▎Markdown编辑和预览 支持在浏览器打开Markdown文件，在浏览器内编辑和预览，只需要右键md文件，使用浏览器打开即可。 ▎收藏夹同步 支持根据收藏夹内容生成1个私有导航网址，便于移动端访问收藏夹网址，实时更新同步，在PC上收藏网站，手机端也可以轻松访问。 ▎剪贴板 在任意标签页复制的文字、链接与图片，会自动进入剪贴板历史。跨标签页共享，切换页面内容不丢失；支持一键复制、导出下载，支持置顶与搜索，上周复制的内容也能找回来。 ▎截图与录屏 支持区域截图、整页长截图和可视区域截图，也能直接录制标签页或屏幕视频。截取完成后，可以在侧边栏里直接标注、复制或保存。 ▎翻译 在网页上选中一段文字，松开即显示译文浮层；也可以一键翻译整个页面，并提供原文对照，方便中英对照阅读。译文支持一键复制保存。 ▎右键直达 在网页任意位置点击右键，常用操作会直接出现在菜单里：右键图片可以做压缩、格式转换或提取颜色；选中文本可以翻译或生成摘要；右键页面空白处可以截图或录屏。 【工具覆盖的场景】 ToolSide 内置了覆盖日常办公与开发场景的一批工具，并在持续增加中： 图片处理：压缩体积、转换格式、调整尺寸、裁剪、拼接，以及识别图片中的文字 文档处理：PDF 文件的合并、拆分与压缩，PDF 与图片的互相转换 文本与数据：格式化与校验结构化数据、格式转换、编解码、字符统计、文档预览 开发辅助：解析令牌、生成随机标识、转换时间格式、查看请求信息等常用操作 AI 能力：总结当前页面或选中的文本、润色改写 效率小件：拾取页面颜色、生成二维码、换算单位、生成强随机密码 不确定某个需求能不能解决？打开侧边栏，用关键词搜索一下，中英文和常用别名都能命中。 【设计理念】 常驻侧边栏：与网页并排显示，收起后只占 36px 极窄入口，不打扰阅读 快捷键唤起：Ctrl+Shift+T（Mac 为 ⌘⇧T）打开侧边栏，Ctrl+K 聚焦搜索，全流程键盘可达 我的工具：收藏常用工具与网站，自定义打开方式 【隐私承诺】 图片、PDF、文本处理默认在你的浏览器本地完成，不上传服务器。你的数据留在你的设备上。 【三步上手】 1. 遇到问题：图片太大、PDF 要合并、一段外文看不懂 2. 点开 ToolSide：点击右侧极窄入口或按快捷键，侧边栏即时展开 3. 搜索并使用：输入关键词选中工具，在侧边栏里直接完成

projects.title: Pim Uijttewaal
projects.summary: Foxifier puts a fox in your menu bar that keeps an eye on your mail. When something new arrives, the fox barks and you see right away who it is from. Free, without ads and fully available in English and Dutch. The app features appealing themes, effects, customisations, auto-update, send feedback, intuitive interface and setup screens

projects.title: SnapBud
projects.summary: SnapBud is a desktop pet that catches your screenshots into a temporary vault instead of letting them pile up on your desktop. A small retro CRT-robot mascot shows you how many it's holding - set a "Wanish" timer (an hour, a day, your call) and it permanently deletes them for you when time's up. No manual sorting, no dragging screenshots to a folder you'll never open again. Just screenshot, use it, and let SnapBud wanish it. Built for Mac and Windows, free to download, no account required.

projects.title: Show HN: OrbitalNote – A modern desktop orgmode editor with calendar and agenda
projects.author: mannders
projects.summary: Hey guys. Last year I switched to nvim-orgmode after trying many different organization systems. I love how it's a standard local plaintext file format that encourages forward motion. It really has helped me become substantially more productive at work. Although at one point I was looking at my apple calendar, and really wished my org agendas were visualized there, especially monthly views. Although there seemed to be caldav exporters etc, I wanted to just open a local desktop app that reads my org folder directly, and show my month. This was the original idea behind OrbitalNote. It does this well, but I had another idea. I used to use Obsidian and appreciate the plaintext markdown philosophy, but for productivity org makes more sense in my opinion. There doesn't seem to be an Obsidian level high quality desktop app with the same plaintext philosophy but geared specifically for org files and workflows. This is what I'm envisioning OrbitalNote could be. This app is free and open source. I will be adding automatic sync with mobile if there's interest. It can be found here: https://orbitalnote.org/ Thank you all for your time, I would love to hear your thoughts.

projects.title: Show HN: MacUp – keep CLI tools up to date from the menu bar
projects.author: patriciobcs

projects.title: Castbar
projects.summary: Control every Chromecast, Google Home and Nest speaker or TV from your Mac's menu bar: see what's playing, pause, skip, seek and set each speaker's volume without picking up your phone. Free and open source. Install: brew tap itssarthak/castbar → brew trust itssarthak/castbar → brew install castbar

projects.title: Zalgo Text Generator
projects.summary: Zalgo Text Generator is a lightweight, ad-free online utility designed to generate cursed, glitched, and void text effects using Unicode combining diacritical marks. Built with instant clipboard copying and custom intensity sliders for Discord, gaming, and social media.

projects.title: [开源推荐] Shotnix：免费开源的 Mac 截图、录屏与视频剪辑工具
projects.author: OMARVII

github.name: OMARVII/Shotnix
github.description: Free, open-source screenshot tool, screen recorder, and video editor for Mac. Auto-zoom, smooth cursor, captions, OCR, scrolling capture, and annotations. Native, private, no account.

projects.summary: Shotnix 是一款用 Swift 原生开发的 macOS 菜单栏工具，把截图、录屏和视频剪辑放进同一个应用：滚动截屏自动拼接成长图，文字识别保留表格和链接；录屏结束后直接进入视频编辑器，按点按自动缩放、在本机生成字幕，还能像改文档一样按文字剪辑视频。无需账号，不上传云端，MIT 开源，界面支持简体中文。 亮点 录完就像剪好了：根据点按位置自动缩放，重绘平滑的系统指针，根据讲解生成字幕，在文字稿里删掉“嗯”“啊”就能从视频中剪掉 截图工具齐全：区域、窗口、全屏、多显示器和滚动截屏，聚光灯、标注气泡、编号步骤、模糊与像素化，可贴到屏幕上 文字识别更实用：多栏按阅读顺序输出，表格可直接粘贴到表格软件，还能扫描二维码和条形码 隐私优先：字幕和文字识别都在本机完成，没有账号、没有统计，只在检查更新时联网 原生轻量：安装包约 11 MB，已签名并通过 Apple 公证，支持应用内更新 代码结构清晰：纯 Swift Package Manager 项目，无 .xcodeproj，界面用 AppKit + SwiftUI，适合学习 ScreenCaptureKit、Vision 和 AVFoundation 的实际用法 截图或演示视频 完整演示视频： 中文说明：

projects.title: Glance Switch
projects.summary: A menu bar app for multi-monitor Macs. It uses your built-in camera to give keyboard focus to the screen, window or split pane you're looking at, so you can just start typing. No clicking first. It brings back the last window you used on each screen and moves the pointer there too. Camera frames stay in memory on your Mac and never leave it. Pause any time with ⇧⌘G.

projects.title: Jefi
projects.summary: Jefi brings mail, calendar, notes and tasks together on your Mac. Turn emails into events or tasks, reply to invitations, link Markdown notes to conversations, and see your day in the menu bar. Search locally, snooze mail and send later. Connect directly to Gmail, Outlook, iCloud or any IMAP provider. AI is optional and off by default. No Jefi account, ads, telemetry or subscription. Try it free for 14 days. A one-time licence covers three Macs.

projects.title: DustByte: Cleaner & Monitor
projects.summary: DustByte is an all-in-one Mac maintenance app built natively in SwiftUI. It cleans caches, logs and browser data (plus dev junk like Xcode DerivedData), finds duplicate and large old files, and uninstalls apps along with their leftovers. A live menu bar monitor shows CPU, GPU, memory, disk, network and battery at a glance. Built for privacy: It's sandboxed by Apple, never asks for Full Disk Access, and your files never leave your Mac.

projects.title: Wisp
projects.summary: Press a shortcut, drag over anything on your Mac's screen (notes, PDFs, videos, charts, code, even text you can't select), and Wisp answers, translates, summarizes or explains it right where you are. No copy-paste, no switching windows. Pick your AI: Gemini (free key), OpenAI, or fully offline with Ollama or LM Studio. Only the area you drag is captured, and there are no Wisp servers. Invisible Ink shows answers as faint, movable text.

projects.title: Talkwondo
projects.summary: Talkwondo gives you full control of your computer by voice, free and with no sign-up. Dictate text live, say punctuation as you go, and fix mistakes with "delete word". With a small free Windows plugin you can also move and click the mouse, scroll, copy and paste into any app, press keys and shortcuts, switch browser tabs and minimise or maximise windows, all hands-free. Every command can be switched on or off, so your words are never mistaken for commands.

projects.title: ClipboardX
projects.summary: ClipboardX syncs text and images between Android and Windows, so you can copy on one device and use it on the other without sending things to yourself through a messenger. It includes clipboard history, an Android keyboard with direct clipboard access, QR device pairing and privacy controls. No account is required. I originally built it to solve my own frustration with moving logs, links and screenshots between my phone and PC.

projects.title: Nextbrowser
projects.summary: Nextbrowser is an open-source desktop app that lets local AI agents like Claude Code or Codex run browser tasks in managed sessions. Browser profiles, proxy and fingerprint rotation, Live View to watch and stop runs, reusable workflows and schedules. macOS & Windows, AGPL-3.0.

projects.title: HealthViewer
projects.summary: HealthViewer is a private, encrypted desktop app for tracking your medical lab results and medications — with no cloud accounts, no subscriptions, and no data sharing.

projects.title: 为了少装几个 Mac 小工具，我把自己的需求做进了 OmniDock
projects.author: xhzone
projects.summary: # 为了少装几个 Mac 小工具，我把自己的需求做进了 OmniDock 大家好，我做了个叫 OmniDock 的 Mac 工具，想放出来给大家试试。 我平时经常在 Windows 和 Mac 之间来回工作。有些 Windows 的操作和系统行为比较合我的习惯，换到 Mac 时，也想继续这么用。 比如，鼠标放到应用图标上，先看看它开着哪些窗口；再次点击图标，把眼前暂时不用的窗口收起来；需要两个窗口并排的时候，用快捷键摆好，不用来回拖。 我就想，能不能把这些用顺手的操作在 Mac 上适配一下？这样换个系统工作时，一些下意识的动作还能接得上，切换起来也自然一点。 这些需求已经有不少工具在解决。 比如 [AltTab]( https://alt-tab.app/) 可以看着缩略图切换窗口，[DockDoor]( https://github.com/ejbills/DockDoor) 可以在 Dock 上悬停预览窗口。调整窗口位置和大小有 [Rectangle]( https://rectangleapp.com/)，找回之前复制的内容有 [Maccy]( https://maccy.app/)。 它们各有侧重。不过，如果这几样功能我都想要，就可能要装几款软件。 我自己的需求又没有那么复杂，很多时候只用得到其中比较常见的那些操作。既然要做，就把这些常用的部分放到一起，也省得为了不同的小需求再去找工具。 OmniDock 就是这样做出来的。目前有这些功能： - 鼠标停在 Dock 图标上查看窗口预览，点选窗口切过去，也支持窗口级快捷切换。 - 再次点击当前应用的 Dock 图标来隐藏它，需要时再点回来。 - 给常用应用设置全局快捷键。 - 用快捷键或拖拽把窗口放到半屏、四角、三分屏等位置。 - 保存、搜索本地剪贴板历史。默认关闭，有需要再开。 - 在支持的 Finder 位置通过右键复制路径、新建文件，以及手动收起不常用的菜单栏图标。 这里有个区别需要说清楚：macOS 的“隐藏应用”会把这个应用的窗口一起藏起来，和最小化一个窗口不一样。所以这些操作是在 Mac 上做适配，具体行为不会和 Windows 完全相同。窗口预览也会受权限和窗口状态影响，官网里有对应说明。 我希望 OmniDock 能把分散在几类工具里的常用功能集中起来，让有类似需求的人少装几个软件。 对我自己来说，最想解决的还是来回切换系统时的那点不习惯：换台电脑继续工作，一些常用操作不用跟着重新适应。 目前可以免费下载，源码在 GitHub 。我把功能录成了一段视频，感兴趣可以先看看： - [官网与下载]( https://omnidock.app/zh/) - [GitHub 源码]( https://github.com/quanzhankeji/OmniDock) - [完整功能演示]( https://youtu.be/Y7r74VQ9Olc) 也想问问同样在 Windows 和 Mac 之间来回用的朋友，你们最希望两边保持一致的是哪个操作？

projects.title: docklayout
projects.summary: macOS has no Dock profiles. docklayout saves the Dock you arranged, folders and spacers included, and puts that row back from a menu bar icon. Size, autohide, and hot corners stay as they are. npx github:nicolas-webdev/docklayout

projects.title: Coursera DL GUI
projects.summary: Lightweight open-source desktop application to locally download Coursera courses using secure browser cookies. A modern GUI replacement for legacy scripts featuring smart throttling and random delays. - courseradl/coursera-dl-gui

projects.title: Meeting Alerter
projects.summary: Meeting Alerter lives in your MacOS menu bar. It counts down to every call and joins meeting in one click.

projects.title: Filesmash Fast file manager for Windows
projects.summary: Filesmash is a native Windows file browser built with C++/Win32 and a custom UI engine, without Electron or a heavy web runtime to make it feel faster, cleaner and more productive. It combines Column View, Quick Preview, fast search, tab workflows, Network Drive support, folder memory, cloud integration, and deeper control over the right-click menu, all in one lightweight desktop app. After months of private beta testing with 400+ of users, Filesmash is now opening up to a wider audience.

projects.title: Promptnote
projects.summary: PromptNote is a lightweight Windows desktop app for organizing your AI prompts. Hit Ctrl+Shift+P from any app to instantly search, copy, or create prompts. Built-in version control tracks every edit so you never lose a winning prompt variation. Read your prompts aloud with one click. 100% offline.

projects.title: Sketchora
projects.summary: Sketchora brings Excalidraw to the desktop with native filesystem integration. Open, edit, and saveexcalidraw files directly from Windows, macOS, and Linux. It supports file associations, native Save/Save As, recent files, and local offline workflows. Open source and MIT licensed, Sketchora aims to make Excalidraw feel like a natural desktop app.

projects.title: Verzeta Studio
projects.summary: Verzeta Studio is an open source desktop app where several AI models work together as a team in one conversation. Each agent has its own provider, model, system prompt and tools, and they hand work to each other by name. Everything runs on your machine, with local or cloud models, no account and no telemetry. Native Qt 6, with Android and VS Code clients.

projects.title: Markdown Reader
projects.summary: Markdown Reader turns local and web Markdown files into elegant, readable documents. 100% offline with zero remote CDNs for ultimate privacy. Features: • Offline MathJax (33 TeX packages) & interactive Mermaid diagrams with zoom/pan • Syntax highlighting for ~300 languages (Prism.js) • 30 themes + auto dark mode • Table of contents & 2,375+ native emoji shortcodes • Live auto-reload for local files • Lightweight Vanilla JS, WCAG 2.1 AA compliant, shortcut Alt+M to toggle raw view.

projects.title: ScrapeGenius
projects.summary: ScrapeGenius helps businesses find and reach verified B2B leads across India. Built as a Windows desktop application, it combines a 20-crore+ record business database with live web scraping (Google Maps, MCA, MSME/Udyam data) to generate targeted contact lists by city, category, or industry. Users can send outreach via integrated WhatsApp (Interakt), email (SendGrid/Brevo), and accept payments through Razorpay — all from one dashboard.

projects.title: [开源推荐] ILoveNotch：把 MacBook 刘海变成随手可用的小托盘

github.name: niyamvora/ILoveNotch
github.description: Free, open-source notch app for MacBooks: now playing, file shelf, calendar, Reminders, notes, shortcuts, timers, camera mirror, and your Claude, Codex, Cursor, and Copilot usage. Native SwiftUI, near-zero idle CPU.

projects.summary: 一款免费开源（MIT）的 macOS 刘海应用，用 SwiftUI 和 AppKit 原生开发。鼠标移到刘海上即可展开：查看任意应用正在播放的内容，把文件暂存到刘海里再拖出或隔空投送，浏览今天的日程，勾选提醒事项，记笔记，运行快捷指令和计时器。在没有刘海的外接显示器上，它会显示为屏幕顶部的悬浮胶囊。适合想让刘海区域派上用场、又不想付费或注册账号的 MacBook 用户。 亮点 事件驱动：没有轮询定时器，隐藏的标签页不占资源，空闲时 CPU 接近 0，CI 里有性能测试把关 正在播放支持任意应用；在 macOS 15.4 及以上通过独立的辅助进程读取，私有框架不会加载进应用本身 无账号、无统计、无许可证服务器，代码可以自己编译 已通过 Apple 签名和公证，支持 Homebrew 安装，应用内自动更新 与同类对比：付费闭源的 NotchNook 本月许可证服务器下线，已购用户无法激活；ILoveNotch 完全免费开源。相比 Boring Notch，它更注重低功耗，并支持提醒事项双向同步和快捷指令

projects.title: Big Weather
projects.summary: Big Weather puts the weather in your Mac's menu bar: the days ahead as one curve you can scrub through, UV hour by hour, and with Premium, AI insights and official weather warnings.

projects.title: SteelType
projects.summary: SteelType is a powerful offline AI voice typing and real-time dictation translation desktop tool. Type 3x faster with absolute privacy.

projects.title: SOUND
projects.summary: macOS has one volume slider and no equalizer. SOUND gives every playing app its own 8-band EQ, independent volume, and output device—right from the menu bar. No virtual audio driver or account; audio stays on your Mac. Free and available in 10 languages.

projects.title: DuoBar
projects.summary: DuoBar is a small macOS menu bar app inspired by the iPhone Duo status bar icon. It puts things like battery, Wi-Fi, network activity, CPU, memory and disk into one compact icon instead of having a separate icon for everything. You can also choose what you want to see and how it's arranged. :)

projects.title: 放弃 Linear 后，我开发了 Gitstride：一个 GitHub Projects 的 macOS 原生客户端
projects.author: zwyyy456
projects.summary: 我之前半年，开发个人项目的时候一直在用 Linear 来进行项目管理。本来我以为免费配额是够用的，但最近几个月，我同时开发多个项目，Issue 就多了起来，Linear 的免费配额就不够用了，因此，我就转向了 GitHub Projects ，毕竟这些项目的代码本来就托管在 GitHub 上。 迁移到 GitHub Projects 之后，我发现它内置的 PR 与 Issue 联动工作流不如 Linear 完善，也不太符合我的需求。比如，当我给一个 Issue 关联 Draft PR 时，我希望这个 Issue 的状态能自动变成 `In Progress`；当 PR 准备好 Review 的时候，Issue 的状态也能跟着变成 `In review`。如果一个 Issue 关联了多个 PR ，我希望等这些 PR 全部合并之后，它才会进入 `Done`，而不是合并其中一个 PR 就算完成了。 此外，我也不太喜欢每次都要打开网页来管理项目，还是更想用本地客户端来操作。 所以，在 codex 的协助下，我用 Swift 6 开发了 [GitStride]( https://gitstride.hyperseek.tech/zh-cn)，一个 GitHub Projects 的 macOS 原生客户端。 GitStride 实现了前面提到的状态联动规则，我不用再随着 PR 的进度手动修改 Issue 状态。如果 Project 里没有 `In review` 这个状态，设置 GitStride 的 PR 自动化后，GitStride 默认会按需为你自动在 Project 中添加这个状态。 > 设置 PR 自动化时，也可以选择后续不追加 In review 这个状态。 GitStride 在菜单栏会常驻一个图标，点击图标可以快速查看项目 Issue ；等我真的要整理任务时，再打开主窗口，在看板或表格视图中创建和编辑 Issue 。 [![pn1KrPe.png]( https://s41.ax1x.com/2026/09/25/pn1KrPe.png)]( https://imgchr.com/i/pn1KrPe) [![pn1K2rt.png]( https://s41.ax1x.com/2026/09/25/pn1K2rt.png)]( https://imgchr.com/i/pn1K2rt) 为了确保创建 Issue 、更新 Issue 描述等需要向 Github 多次发送请求的操作的跟手，GitStride 开发时借鉴了 Linear 的 local-first 的理念。GitStride 会把项目快照缓存在本机。修改改状态后，界面会先显示变化，再同步到 GitHub ；创建或编辑 Issue 提交后，app 会马上显示新内容，后台处理向 Github 发起的请求。 GitStride 还支持创建 Backlog 状态的 Issue ，新建 Issue 时可以直接选择 Backlog 状态；如果 Project 里没有这个状态，GitStride 会自动补上。 项目已经[开源在 GitHub]( https://github.com/zwyyy456/GitBoard)。如果你也在用 GitHub Projects ，欢迎试试，如果觉得好用，还请给个 Star 。更多介绍，参见 [GitStride 官网]( https://gitstride.hyperseek.tech) 下一步计划 1. 添加命令面板功能、完善 app 内的快捷键操作 2. 添加甘特图视图

projects.title: Show HN: Whiteboard (YC W26) – An open-source IDE for thoughtful software design
projects.author: sidharthkmenon

github.name: devdotfast/whiteboard
github.description: open-source canvas for thoughtful software design

projects.summary: Hello! We’re Sid, Alex, Ketan, and Milan. We’re building Whiteboard ( https://whiteboard.dev.fast/ ), an open-source desktop app where humans and agents can architect software together in a common workspace. Here’s our repo: https://github.com/devdotfast/whiteboard . We were missing the feeling of a “whiteboard session” with another dev where you leave with a deep understanding of a system, so we built this app for ourselves. Whiteboard plugs into the tools you already use - e.g. Claude Code, Codex, etc. – and gives your agent an SDK to draw on an in-app canvas to describe its work. We began with an MVP based on HTML artifacts and started rethinking the app as we ran into limitations: 1. Built on top of CodeOSS: We found that in pure HTML tools it was hard to connect a spec or diagram to code. In Whiteboard, when you click on visualizations like a sequence diagram, an entity relationship diagram, or a quote from the agent’s trace, you can jump to the underlying code directly. When navigating code, you get keybindings and LSP support from VSCode out of the box. We’ve found this is especially valuable because tradeoffs are often only discovered after a first pass at implementation (re: slop) 2. Semantic diff viewer: we wrote a semantic, AST-aware diff viewer in Rust so you can only view the code changes which are relevant to you [1]. We’ve set up some sane defaults: large added functions are summarized as pseudocode, and things like unit tests and large documentation changes are collapsed / hidden. This is all customizable with a WASM-based plugin system. 3. Decision Log: We found it difficult to reason about what set of decisions our agents made autonomously. So we built tools for agents to query and link their own traces to the Whiteboard, so you can understand how the requirements that you set were implemented, and understand what decisions your agent made autonomously. Here’s a quick demo video explaining more: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ChPn3ftULWE Folks at companies like Salesforce and Modal are using Whiteboard today as a review tool for architecture or spec-level changes – really any change where they want to be involved: 1. Reviewing your own coding agent’s work: because Whiteboard makes it easier to review large amounts of code, folks will typically have their AI agents create a prototype and a corresponding Whiteboard session so they can iterate on the design. 2. Reviewing other people’s changes: We’ve found that Whiteboard is particularly helpful when composed with tools like Greptile. For example, you can run an automated code reviewer on small changes and escalate to a Whiteboard session for the changes that require human judgement. Why we built this: we’re four buddies from college who quit our jobs as tech leads right before agentic coding became industry standard. As we iterated towards an MVP for a previous idea, we struggled to maintain a comprehensible codebase while reaping all the velocity benefits of agentic coding. As more PRs were merged without our understanding, we felt a ‘cognitive debt’ begin to seep in, until it became difficult for us to even contribute to the system [2]. We’re releasing our desktop app under an MIT license. Please poke through and feel free to contribute! Eventually we’ll charge companies for a hosted web version that manages whiteboard session creation alongside features like trajectory storage and multiplayer reviews. Everything will always remain self-hostable. Thanks for reading, and we hope you try it out! We would love to hear any feedback and to learn from your expertise. Here’s are the project links again: https://github.com/devdotfast/whiteboard , and you can install (for MacOS + Linux) at https://install.dev.fast [1] diffs library: https://github.com/devdotfast/diffr [2] Credit for the term ‘cognitive debt’ goes to https://www.geoffreylitt.com/2026/07/02/understanding-is-the...

projects.title: Show HN: See your portfolio in your Mac Menubar
projects.author: tma
projects.summary: We see tons of interesting and complex finance apps getting built at SnapTrade, but personally I prefer something dead simple and minimalistic. This is a no-fuss, quick way to see your portfolio balance and top holdings on a Mac. I have all my personal brokerage accounts stored at SnapTrade, so sharing access of my investments to the app is a one-click OAuth grant. Free to download, free to link your accounts, would love to see what HN thinks!

projects.title: Algenius
projects.summary: Algenius is a Windows & Linux desktop app that combines automatic AI daily activity logging, screenshot capture/editing (Alt+Q area, Alt+A full screen), and an AI Text Assistant (Alt+S) to translate, rewrite tone, and fix grammar on selected text in any app. Free forever for unlimited screenshots and basic editor. Pro ($15.99/mo, 14-day trial) adds activity logger & reports, OCR/text extraction, AI Text Assistant, before/after compare, and custom watermark branding.

projects.title: PicXure
projects.summary: PicXure is a lightweight, native macOS menu bar image annotator. Paste a screenshot, mark it up with arrows, text, shapes, highlights, numbers and more, then copy the finished image back to your clipboard. Crop, rotate and resize when needed. Free to try, with a $14.99 one-time Pro upgrade.

projects.title: omo
projects.summary: omo is a small macOS menu bar utility for arranging windows with keyboard shortcuts: halves, quarters, thirds, fullscreen, centered, or moved over to another display.

projects.title: Wektor
projects.summary: Wektor is a desktop app that answers questions about your CSV or database in plain English, without uploading your actual data anywhere. Only column names and aggregate stats reach the AI model you connect (your own key). The model writes analysis code from that summary, and it runs locally in a sandboxed process against your real data. Charts, trend detection, PDF reports, and a presentation mode included. Free tier works fully offline with sample data, no signup, no API key.

projects.title: Mino
projects.summary: Mino keeps your to-dos and focus timer in your Mac’s menu bar. Add a task when it comes to mind, check it off when it’s done, or start a focus session without opening a separate app or managing another dashboard. I built it for the moments when you need to see what’s next, then get back to work. Your tasks stay close when you need them and out of the way when you don’t.

projects.title: dsh-win32
projects.summary: Use DeepSeek Harness on native Windows without guessing what's broken. dsh-win32 checks prerequisites, creates a desktop shortcut, and diagnoses known native-load failures. Optional live verification tests the installed PowerShell and Windows ACL sandbox without a model key. If an old plugin blocks startup, preview its deactivation and apply it with a manifest backup. Free, open source, and built for an existing DSH installation.

projects.title: NetSpeed
projects.summary: NetSpeed is a lightweight native macOS menu bar app for live network speed, data usage and one-click speed tests - yashchavda96/NetSpeed

projects.title: Claude Watch
projects.summary: Claude Watch puts every Claude Code session in your menu bar: working, waiting on you, done, or failed. macOS 14 or later. Free and open source.

projects.title: Split
projects.summary: Split is a macOS menu-bar window manager. Arrange windows, then drag their shared divider to resize both while their contents update live. Click the divider to swap sides. Click a side's window count to open its switcher; click again to cycle through stacked windows. Works with left-right and top-bottom layouts. $4.99 once for one active Mac. macOS 13+, Apple silicon and Intel.

projects.title: Pingr
projects.summary: Pingr pulls GitHub, Slack, WhatsApp, Gmail, Discord, Linear and more into one menu bar panel. Group by channel, search everything locally, snooze what can wait, and get an AI brief of what happened while you were away. Local-first, macOS 13+.

projects.title: Superdock
projects.summary: A free Mac Dock alternative that gives every Chrome profile its own icon. Some extras like Window previews, Alt-Tab switcher and a dock on every display, one mouse click shortcut to mission control and stage manager Free to download

projects.title: JAST
projects.summary: Spending more time managing your text expander than using it? JAST pairs a refreshingly clean interface with powerful snippets, variables, and macros, without the clutter or complexity. Whether you answer customer questions, write code, or repeat messages every day, turn repetitive work into shortcuts. Create reusable text, fill in changing details, and connect actions with macros, all at an affordable price.

projects.title: DuckLocal
projects.summary: DuckLocal is a free, open-source desktop app built on DuckDB: drop in CSV, Parquet, JSON or Excel files and query them with SQL. No server, no upload, no account.

projects.title: Madriss
projects.summary: Madriss records your purchases without a bank login. Your bank already texts you about every transaction, so a one-time Shortcuts automation hands that alert to Madriss on your iPhone — mada, online and subscription payments log themselves, and the message never leaves your phone. Apple Pay taps get a one-tap category prompt in the Dynamic Island. Budgets that warn before the limit, a monthly breakdown, and Household: one shared feed for you and your partner. Arabic-first, free, no trackers.

projects.title: OmniNotch
projects.summary: OmniNotch turns your MacBook notch into a real workspace. Twenty tools in one hover: Ask Omni (on-device Apple Intelligence), now playing, clipboard, file shelf & AirDrop, teleprompter, timers, weather, stocks, live AI usage, and more. Native. Private. No account. No cloud. No telemetry. Lifetime license - $14.99, up to 3 Macs.

projects.title: Thawdrop
projects.summary: Thawdrop shares files and folders straight from your computer with a link or QR code. Nothing is uploaded and nothing sits on a server, so there's no size limit. The receiver only needs a browser: they see the file list and download just the files they pick. Add a password (encrypted before sharing), an expiry time or a download limit. Desktop app for macOS and Windows. Open source under MIT.

projects.title: zqlcrab
projects.summary: zqlcrab is a fast, lightweight, open-source database desktop client for SQLite, PostgreSQL, and MySQL. Built in Rust with Zed’s GPUI instead of Electron, it delivers a responsive 120 FPS native interface, in-place data editing with staged changeset review, a SQL console, visual EXPLAIN plans, schema tools, query history, and CSV, JSON, Markdown, and SQL export. Available for macOS, Linux, and Windows.

projects.title: Show HN: Cloud-based email and calendar sync platform and Android app – for sale
projects.author: uncle_kostya
projects.summary: Hello, My name is Kostya Vasilyev and I was the original developer of an Android email app called Aqua Mail, sold to MobiSystems in 2019 at 3.5 organically grown users. After that, I built a new email app called Sugar Mail, based on a cloud email sync platform. The project hasn't been a success with end users, but I think the sync platform could be useful to someone so I'm looking to sell it and include the app too. Mail sync runs in the cloud and supports IMAP and Exchange, both with push mail, and the latter with bi-directional calendar and contact sync. Both Office 365 and on-prem Exchange are supported. Running mail sync in the cloud allows the Android app to be very efficient in terms of battery use. The Android app is just a JSON RPC client with some UI on top - so building an iOS or a desktop app would be pretty easy for the buyer. There are several geo-distributed server nodes and the Android app uses the closest one. Adding nodes for capacity is easy. The project is actively maintaned, with the Android app optimized for Android 17. The server is written in Go. I recently rewrote it in Rust, but decided to stay with Go in production for a variety of reasons (would be happy to explain in more detail). Unit economics: a $10 VPS can handle 1000 users each averaging 2 email accounts. A comparable platform is Nylas which charges $15/month per 10 accounts and has no end-user app (they used to, but not anymore). More details here: https://sugarmail.app/for-sale-one-pager.html Happy to answer questions.

github.name: Leexunhuan743/SyncClipboardCfServer
github.description: SyncClipboard 官方同步服务器的 Cloudflare Workers 复刻（TypeScript + D1 + R2 + Durable Objects），协议兼容官方客户端

projects.summary: （MIT） SyncClipboard 官方服务端的 Cloudflare Workers 复刻实现（TypeScript + D1 + R2 + Durable Objects）。官方客户端（Windows / macOS / Android，v3.1.1 及以上）零改动，把服务器地址指向部署好的 Worker 就能用：剪贴板实时同步（SignalR WebSocket 长连接）、WebDAV 兼容端点、历史记录跨设备同步。 做它的原因：官方服务端要自备 VPS / Docker / 进程守护，而这个实现把服务端搬到 Cloudflare 边缘——无服务器、免运维、按量计费，个人用量基本落在免费额度内（一台客户端全天在线约 1.7 万次请求/天，免费额度 10 万次/天）。 比官方多出来的： 内置 Web 历史管理界面：浏览 / 搜索 / 筛选 / 排序历史记录，收藏、置顶、批量操作、文本与图片预览、复制下载；回收站（删除的记录连同图片/文件数据保留 30 天，可一键恢复）；在线调整保留策略，不用重新部署。 部署两条路：命令行（wrangler），或 GitHub Actions（Fork 后配几个 Secret，推 master 自动建资源并部署）。 与官方服务端的行为差异（先说清楚，避免踩坑）： 单次上传默认上限 48 MiB（可调到 64 MiB），超出返回 413； 文件夹 zip 解压总量 64 MiB、条目 1000、单条目 24 MiB； 历史清理每 20 分钟一轮； 访问不存在的地址且未带凭据时返回 401，并计入失败限速。 这些限制来自 Cloudflare 免费档的约束（单请求 100 MiB、isolate 内存 128 MiB）；客户端默认单文件 20 MB，正常使用大多碰不到。 工程上：协议行为逐条对照官方源码实现，并与官方发布件做过 A/B 实测；22 个测试套件；所有有意偏离都登记在 docs/protocol.md 的差异表里。 独立的社区实现，与官方项目无关联、未获官方背书；协议行为与哈希算法移植自官方（MIT，版权声明已保留在 LICENSE 中）。

projects.title: 做了个 macOS 27 菜单栏辅助小工具，让原生折叠范围可以主动控制
projects.author: Superoutman
projects.summary: 升级到 macOS 27 后，系统终于把菜单栏图标折叠做进了原生功能。但实际用下来，我觉得它目前阶段更像一个「半成品」：只有菜单栏图标比较多、空间不足时，系统才会触发隐藏功能。 我的需求其实更简单，不管菜单栏有没有挤满，我都希望把不常用的图标先收起来，需要的时候再一键展开。 所以费尽心思打磨了一个很小的 macOS 工具：ShiftBar 。 https://i.v2ex.co/W1518244l.png ShiftBar 没有重新做一套菜单栏，也不是想做成 Bartender / Ice / Thaw 那种功能比较完整的 Menu Bar Manager 。 它的思路反而是尽量利用 macOS 27 已经提供的原生菜单栏折叠能力，只补上我自己觉得缺少的那部分控制，它甚至没有设置页面（全部在图标和菜单中完成）。 目前主要做了这些： * 自定义菜单栏图标的隐藏范围 * 单击胶囊即可展开 / 收起（基于 macOS 27 原生折叠机制） * Shift + 拖动快速调整隐藏范围 * 记住设置好的隐藏范围 * 支持菜单栏布局备份与恢复 * 右键点击胶囊图标查看使用方法 为什么系统已经有原生折叠了，还要做这个？如果只是想永久隐藏几个菜单栏图标，macOS 自己现在已经能解决了，确实没必要再装一个工具。但我更想要的是什么时候折叠、折叠多少，由自己决定，不必等菜单栏真的挤满。所以 ShiftBar 的定位不是取代 macOS 27 的原生功能，而是做它的一个很轻的补充，本体才 3MB 多。 ⸻ 目前还是比较早期的版本，我自己也在持续使用和调整。 如果大家已经升级 macOS 27 ，也欢迎帮忙试试看。尤其想听听大家对于原生菜单栏折叠的使用感受，以及还有哪些地方觉得不够顺手。 ShiftBar： https://shiftbar.0x01.build/

projects.title: Show HN: Napkin – a scratchpad that holds texts and images for copy
projects.author: ppnpm
projects.summary: Napkin is a simple scratchpad to hold text and images to copy later or until you don't need them anymore, or when you don't want to organize temporary files. Clipboard does a similar kind of job, but it is essentially meant for copy and paste, it is volatile. Normally, you can't access the image or text you copied 10 days ago on clipboard. And that's fine—that's what clipboards are meant for. Napkin lets you create napkins on which you can add or paste pieces of text, URLs, and images. You can edit the text, insert images from your desktop, and copy any item at any time for further use somewhere else. Keep the app running in background, and reuse the items you pasted. Nothing is organized. You don't have to give anything a title or add tags. This is where all your mess gets dumped until you decide it's no longer useful and delete it. Just like a scratchpad! Deleted napkins go into the trash and are kept there for N days (30 by default), which you can change in the settings. Napkins older than X days (30 by default) will be flagged for deletion. You can change this period in the settings as well. You can also empty the trash, after which the files will be permanently deleted from your desktop. AI disclosure: This is a vibe-coded project. I spent most of my time testing it on Linux. Windows testing wasn't done properly, although it did run on Windows with some issues. If you try it, please test it on your system as well, and if you find any problems, feel free to submit an issue. Some notes you may need to know: - Linux builds are tested on Arch/KDE/Wayland. Windows builds and passes the full suite in CI, I ran older versions on real hardware and they worked. It is an unsigned build, so SmartScreen will warn you. - There is no global capture hotkey yet, which is the thing I most want. It needs the XDG GlobalShortcuts portal, and the session handshake. I cannot develop it headless. - There is no at-rest encryption. A scratch surface ends up holding tokens and passwords. The data directory is 0700 and excluded from desktop search, but that is retention, not encryption. Github URL : https://github.com/sudomonas/napkin

projects.author: sayonidroy

github.name: SupercmoHQ/superCMO-skills
github.description: Open-source skills that empower any AI agent (Claude, Cursor, Hermes, etc.) to generate end-to-end marketing campaigns - UGC videos, ad videos, product photography and more.

projects.summary: Hey there! We are building SuperCMO Skills, open source tools which allow agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.) to research, plan and create video and image campaigns end-to-end right out of your terminal or IDE. We got tired of paying for expensive AI subscriptions and wasting countless hours assembling a pipeline for just one video ad, so we created these tools for ourselves. SuperCMO integrates with your agents to provide the ability to plan, shoot, edit, and stitch complete campaigns. We began with simple prompt wrappers but soon realized the need to rethink our entire pipeline to overcome common limitations of the AI video. - Pipeline Orchestration: Creating one ad now requires jumping through several apps: writing scripts in one, creating images in another, recording audio in yet another, and stitching the whole thing in an editor. SuperCMO does all of that natively. The tool knows how to choose the appropriate model (like automatically switching prompts for Veo versus Seedance) and do the whole post-production, including trimming and voiceover synchronization. - Consistency from Shot to Shot: In true AI video generators, products and actors continually transform from shot to shot. We solved that problem by storyboarding before rendering and locking in master reference images in every generation. - Directional Control: Completely automated agents often go awry creatively. So, we've developed the capabilities to take a peek at every stage of the process. You're always in control, approving the creator, the story idea, and the script before anything is expensively rendered. People are using this today to create UGC product ads (give the agent a product photo and it chooses the creator, generates the script, and creates a ready MP4 file) or to analyze competitors' work (agent analyzes the winning advertisement from the competitor and recreates it with your product in mind). This project will be released under an Apache-2.0 license. You can come to us with your own vendor keys to have everything done for free or to generate using our keys and just pay for each usage without any lock-in. Thank you for your attention!

projects.title: 【网站自荐】SupaQR：把二维码、短链接和文件分享整合到一起的在线工具
projects.author: cenaczx
projects.summary: 【网站自荐】SupaQR：一个把二维码、短链接和文件分享放在一起的在线工具 大家好，向大家自荐一个我自己开发的产品 SupaQR： SupaQR 是一个集 二维码生成、短链接、文件分享和访问统计 于一体的在线工具。 最开始它只是一个二维码生成器，后来随着自己不断使用，我发现二维码背后真正需要解决的问题，往往并不只是“生成一张二维码图片”。 比如： 印刷出去的二维码，目标链接以后可能需要修改 想知道二维码到底有没有人扫、什么时候扫、从哪里扫 想把 PDF、图片、音频等文件直接变成二维码 营销活动需要批量生成二维码 一个很长的网址，希望变成容易传播的短链接 文件发给客户以后，希望知道有没有被打开 希望二维码和短链接都能使用自己的品牌域名 这些需求通常需要几个不同的工具才能完成。 所以我慢慢把 SupaQR 做成了现在这个样子，希望尽量用一个产品解决从： 二维码 / 短链接 → 分享 → 访问 → 数据统计 这一整套流程。 为什么开发 SupaQR？ 市面上其实已经有很多优秀的二维码和短链接产品。 但我自己使用这些产品时，一直有两个比较明显的感受。 第一个是功能比较分散。 二维码生成、URL Shortener、文件分享、访问统计，经常分别属于不同的产品。 第二个是很多二维码工具的定价并不便宜。 尤其是动态二维码。 二维码一旦印在包装、宣传册、名片或者线下物料上，重新印刷的成本其实远远高于二维码本身。 所以我希望 SupaQR 能做成一个： 功能足够完整，但价格尽量简单、便宜，而且普通人不需要研究半天就能使用的工具。 目前可以做什么？ 1. 动态二维码 可以创建动态二维码。 二维码印刷以后，即使目标网址发生变化，也可以直接修改二维码背后的目标内容，不需要重新生成和印刷二维码。 同时可以查看二维码的扫描数据。 2. 自定义二维码样式 支持修改： 颜色 Pattern Eye 样式 Frame Logo 生成以后可以下载 PNG、JPG、SVG、EPS 等格式。 所以除了网页使用，也比较适合包装、海报、宣传册等需要高清打印的场景。 3. 多种二维码类型 除了普通网址二维码，目前还可以创建包括： URL File Document vCard Page Form Menu App Store Image Audio Video 等不同类型的二维码。 4. 短链接 SupaQR 同时也是一个 URL Shortener。 可以： 创建短链接 自定义短链接后缀 使用自己的域名 查看点击统计 设置链接过期时间 批量创建链接 这样二维码和短链接的数据可以放在同一个后台管理。 5. 文件分享 可以直接上传： 图片 PDF Word Excel PPT 视频 音频 Markdown 3D 文件 等文件。 上传以后可以生成分享链接或者二维码。 同时支持密码、过期时间、下载限制和访问统计等功能。 所以有时候甚至不需要自己先找地方托管 PDF，再生成二维码。 6. 数据统计 动态二维码和短链接都可以记录访问数据。 对于线下宣传来说，我觉得这个功能比较有价值。 因为以前印一张传单或者贴一个海报，基本不知道到底有没有人看。 换成动态二维码以后，至少可以知道： 这张二维码有没有人扫描。 也可以进一步分析不同二维码、不同渠道和不同线下位置带来的访问效果。 7. API SupaQR 也提供 API： 如果需要批量生成二维码或者把二维码、短链接能力接入自己的系统，可以直接通过 API 完成。 免费版 SupaQR 有免费版本，不需要信用卡。 目前免费计划可以创建动态二维码、静态二维码和短链接，并且二维码扫描次数不限。 对于个人项目、小网站或者只是偶尔需要制作二维码的人，免费版本基本就可以直接开始使用。 我比较想做的一件事 我不太希望 SupaQR 最后只是变成一个： “输入网址 → 下载二维码” 的工具。 我更希望二维码成为连接现实世界和网页服务的一个入口。 比如一家餐厅贴出的二维码，背后不只是一个 PDF； 一家维修公司的车辆上贴出的二维码，背后也不一定只是官方网站； 展会、产品包装、门店、设备、名片等线下场景，其实都可以通过二维码连接到不同的网页应用和后续操作。 所以我现在也在继续尝试，让 SupaQR 从单纯的 QR Code Generator，慢慢变成： Scan → Action → Track 即： 扫码 → 完成操作 → 记录结果 而不仅仅是“扫完跳到一个网址”。 这个方向目前还在持续开发。 一些适合 SupaQR 的场景 目前我觉得比较典型的场景包括： 餐厅菜单二维码 产品包装二维码 PDF / 产品手册二维码 展会宣传二维码 名片 / vCard Wi-Fi 二维码 App 下载二维码 音频导览 活动二维码 短链接营销 文件分享 印刷品访问统计 如果你的二维码以后可能修改内容，建议使用动态二维码； 如果内容永远不会变化，用静态二维码就足够了。 最后 这是一个还在持续开发中的产品。
